event_name: Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals

pairs.note:
2:55 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 80 degrees, relative humidity 48 percent, barometer 30.07 inches, adjusted altitude 2,764 feet, track temperature 129 degrees.

Capps is 43 - 42 against Hagan in prior events. 

Capps and Hagan have raced 85 times...Hagan has “left first” 46 times.
Capps average R/T in those 85 races is .073
Hagan's average R/T in those 85 races is .065
In Rd. 3 races Matt Hagan is 15 - 14 against Capps

The winner of this race will win the regular season championship.

Hagan goes down the groove with a clean, straight pass to win the regular season championship ad move on to the final round. Capps hits the throttle and goes up in smoke.

Hagan is going to his 103rd final round.

Prock is 7 - 5 against Beckman in prior events. 

Beckman and Prock have raced 12 times.
In those 12 races Prock has “left first” 7 times.

Prock leaves first but goes up in smoke. Beckman goes down the groove with another good run to take the win.

Beckman is going to his 81st career final round.

Beckman will have lane choice over Hagan in the final round.
